mentions.description: A book club themed event calendar for New Yorkers that also runs an official monthly in-person meeting for book club matchmaking.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I'm hosting an book club themed event calendar for New Yorkers!

We also have an official meeting once a month to do book club matchmaking in person.
